hero.title: Backend Developer
hero.description: Backend Developer with training in Web Application Development (DAW). I build robust REST APIs with Java and Spring Boot, with experience in JWT authentication, data persistence, and clean architecture. Projects deployed to production.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: I build robust APIs and backend systems, from the database to the business logic.
about.description: I build complete REST APIs with Java and Spring Boot: authentication and authorization with Spring Security (JWT), persistence with JPA/Hibernate, and testing with JUnit and Mockito. I also know React and TypeScript, which lets me understand how the API gets consumed end to end.
about.meta: Crevillente (Alicante) · Available for remote, on-site and hybrid work

devrecipes.description: Full recipe management platform with JWT authentication. Users can register, log in, publish recipes and explore others'. Backend with Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate and MySQL. Frontend with React and TypeScript. Deployed on Vercel and Railway.

slotlyfy.description: Multi-business SaaS booking platform (Booksy-style). Full REST API with JWT authentication, roles and real ownership, pagination, caching, transactional email notifications and OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.

devmovies.description: Full stack movie platform. Backend with Spring Boot exposing own REST endpoints that act as intermediary between the frontend and the TMDB API. Frontend in React and TypeScript. Displays popular, top-rated, now playing, upcoming movies and search by title.

tiendamusica.description: REST API for managing artists and albums, with a bidirectional Artist–Album relationship. Stack: Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, MySQL, Bean Validation, global exception handling. Unit testing (Mockito) and integration testing (MockMvc). Dockerized with Docker Compose (app + MySQL).

gestorbiblioteca.description: REST API for managing authors, books and loans, with its own business rule: a book cannot be loaned if it's already on loan. Uses DTOs and mappers to separate the persistence layer from the API response. Unit testing with Mockito. Dockerized with Docker Compose (MySQL healthcheck).

spaceexplorer.description: Space exploration app consuming real NASA APIs (APOD, EPIC, NeoWs, Image Library). Custom hooks for data logic, loading and error handling. Unit tests for hooks with fetch mocking.

taskflow.description: Task management application built with React and TypeScript. Includes simulated authentication with protected routes, full CRUD with inline editing, global state via Context API and custom hooks, task filtering by status and tests with Vitest and React Testing Library.

appclima.description: Interactive web application showing real-time weather information. Built with React, Tailwind and TypeScript to practice reusable components and responsive design.

medicinachina.description: Version developed in React and Tailwind of a project previously built in WordPress. The goal was to migrate the structure to a more flexible and modern environment, improving performance and customization.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Do you have a project or vacancy where my stack fits? Drop me a line and let's talk.
